name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening, folks. South Carolina State shut Savannah State out entirely on defense while their offense ran wild. But Florida A&M is a different animal. Does that production travel?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, that line up front ain't just showing up, they shielding like pros; if they keep that pocket clean, that offense gon' keep lighting it up against any defense they face.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Now Cassius, I hear you, but let's not forget Savannah State didn't put a single point on the board. That's a different kind of coverage than what FAMU will bring.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Aight, I see Savannah State was a soft test, but that offensive line locking down like that? That's a skill, not luck. FAMU gonna feel it.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, that eighty-seven point night came against a team that scored zero. What tells you the line holds when the other side hits back?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Malachi Jones crossing the end zone ain't just a highlight, it’s proof that South Carolina State can punch through when it counts ... execution like that'll survive the test.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, that kind of execution is impressive, Cassius, but when you give up zero points, it lets the offense swing for the fences. FAMU's defense won't be as forgiving.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: And that's the thing, folks: South Carolina State's defense allowed no points to Savannah State. That changes the whole ballgame for an offense, doesn't it?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, a shutout looks nice, but Savannah State was folding before the game even started...defense ain't the headline here, it's that offense breaking through no cap.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Andrew, fair point on the shutout, but what's your actual evidence FAMU's defense is built to stop that specific line? Or is this just an assumption they're tougher?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Look, strong fundamentals ain't just for show, they adapt on the fly...pressure hits, they pivot, protect, still find the paint. FAMU's gonna see that fire, no doubt.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Here's what neither of you has actually addressed: an eighty-seven to nothing final tells us nothing about how that line performs under real resistance, because there wasn't any.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Pull up on this...lines that dominant don’t just disappear when the heat turns up; they adjust, absorb, then break through. Real tests don’t expose weakness, they prove legacy.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: "Legacy" is a word, Cassius, not a stat. Nothing on that scoreboard proves resistance, because there wasn't any to survive.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, no cap, when you roll out that kind of protection, it’s like a blueprint for anyone trying to stop you – FAMU's gotta bring more than talk to the line.
